review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This experienced technical contributor will support production operations, infrastructure reliability, security controls, and compliance requirements in a highly regulated environment. The role calls for a hands-on network professional who can independently troubleshoot complex environments, follow controlled operational processes, and maintain clear, audit-ready documentation. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Hands-on experience administering Palo Alto and Cisco firewalls, supporting Cisco switching, and maintaining enterprise production infrastructure. Preferred certifications include CCNA or CCNP, Security+, Palo Alto PCNSA or PCNSE, CISSP, Azure or AWS networking certifications, and ITIL Foundation.
